name: Moonta Bay
objection: Moonta and Port Hughes already cover this coast; Moonta Bay is a beach suburb of Moonta, so it may be a near-duplicate (rule 3).

name: Port Victoria
objection: Wardang Island, its famous shipwreck trail, is closed to visitors (Point Pearce lands), so the town's draw is smaller than it sounds.

name: Maitland
objection: Inland service town with a hospital; no source says what to see, so a visitor would not go out of the way (rule 2).

name: Point Turton
objection: Holiday village with a caravan park; no source names a specific beach or sight.

name: Corny Point
objection: Lighthouse may be closed or exterior only; the village itself is a few houses.

name: Stenhouse Bay
objection: Part of Innes National Park, which may itself be the destination, so it could be a near-duplicate of the park (rule 3).

name: Inneston
objection: Ruins are unstable and walk-through only; could be judged part of the park.

name: Black Point
objection: Holiday shacks with no named sight.

name: Ethel Wreck
objection: Wreck is largely buried and sometimes just a few ribs; parks page calls it a 'rare look', so visibility varies.

name: Cape Spencer Lighthouse
objection: Lighthouse itself is not open to the public; the draw is the lookout.

name: West Cape Headland Hike
objection: One agency source and a short walk; West Cape picnic area might be a separate duplicate.

name: Stenhouse Bay Lookout Walk
objection: Starts at Stenhouse Bay, which is kept, so it may count as part of that spot (rule 3).

name: Thomson-Pfitzner Plaster Trail
objection: One source, overlaps Inneston and Stenhouse Bay, and part of Walk the Yorke.

name: Gym Beach Hike
objection: Long hike with one source, little to see named.

name: Royston Head
objection: One source only; hike of 2 hours may be seen as part of the park.

name: Pondalowie Bay
objection: Campground-driven; the beach may not be distinct from the park.

name: Investigator Strait Shipwreck Trail
objection: A multi-site trail rather than one place; Ethel Wreck already covers the main stop.

name: Dolphin Beach
objection: Only a one-line mention, with no description of what to do.

name: Copper Rail Trail
objection: A linear shared path with little scenery; may be seen as a facility rather than a draw.

name: Wheal Hughes Copper Mine
objection: Tour needs booking and one operator; Moonta Mines heritage area already covers the mining theme.

name: Splash Town
objection: A council playground-style venue, only useful in summer for families; not a destination in its own right.

name: Moonta Bay Beach
objection: One source, 0 page views; Wallaroo's North Beach and others are similar.

name: The Farm Shed Museum and Tourism Centre
objection: Volunteer-run museum with limited hours and heat closures.

name: Wallaroo Heritage and Nautical Museum
objection: Small local museum; its draw is local history only.

name: North Beach, Wallaroo
objection: Another plain town beach.

name: Wallaroo Mines
objection: Could be a free heritage walk, but unverified.

name: Port Broughton Heritage Centre and Museum
objection: It is the only See item besides the jetty on Wikivoyage's Port Broughton page.

name: Bublacowie Military Museum
objection: The Peninsula has few military sights, but no tourism-board listing was found.

name: Port Victoria Maritime Museum
objection: Port Victoria has no other indoor sight and Wikipedia has an article.

name: Bute Fauna Park
objection: A fauna park would be a family draw in a thin inland area.

name: Point Turton Beach
objection: Beaches are named stops, and the Peninsula's southern coast has few listed.

name: Minlaton Harry Butler Red Devil Memorial
objection: One counted source, a 15-30 minute stop, and it is a memorial by name; could be a minor memorial or fail as a roadside look.

name: Corny Point Lighthouse
objection: Only the township appears on the site, not the lighthouse itself; page views 222, the lighthouse is mostly seen from outside; thin evidence.

name: Ardrossan Heritage Museum
objection: One source only, 0 views, small-town volunteer museum with limited hours; arguably a local venue.

name: Stansbury Museum
objection: Short opening hours, small museum, local history; not worth a trip.

name: Edithburgh Museum
objection: One counted source, small hours, local history museum.

name: Sultana Point
objection: Only one counted source and beach is small; page views 242.

name: Edithburgh Tidal Pool
objection: Local swimming pool; a tidal pool is a modest draw, a half hour swim.

name: Edithburgh Jetty
objection: Divers only in practice; a jetty is not a distinct sight for general visitors; duplicate of other YP jetties.

name: Troubridge Island
objection: Permit and boat access needed; most visitors will not go; seabird sanctuary with restricted access.

name: Wool Bay Jetty and Lime Kilns
objection: Only the town name is in the source I could open, not the kilns specifically; a ten-minute look.

name: Yorketown Pink Lakes
objection: Colour is not there whenever you arrive, the entry is a generic group of lakes (duplicate of Salt Lake Trail), no named access point.

name: Tiddy Widdy Beach
objection: No beach-specific description found; one source only.
